notes: Tax code 1257L on the cumulative basis, monthly pay of £4,166.67, bonus paid in tax month 12.

Withholding equals the liability by design: in month 12 cumulative PAYE brings the year's deductions to the tax on the year's pay under the tax code. Any gap comes from the £9 a tax code adds to the allowance and from the Personal Allowance taper over £100,000, which the code does not apply until HMRC changes it.

Employee National Insurance is worked out on each month's pay on its own (not cumulatively) and is a final charge, so the NIC withheld is the NIC due. Directors (annual earnings period) are not covered.
Student and postgraduate loan deductions and pension contributions are not included.
